Balance.description: Product: ALL Description: Specifies the open balance amount or the amount unpaid by the vendor. For the create operation, this represents the opening balance for the vendor. When returned in response to the query request it represents the current open balance (unpaid amount) for that vendor. Filterable: QBW Sortable: QBW

BillRate.description: BillRate can be set to specify this vendor's hourly billing rate.

OpenBalanceDate.description: Specifies the date of the Open Balance. Non QB-writable.

CreditLimit.description: Specifies the maximum amount of an unpaid vendor balance.

AcctNum.description: Name or number of the account associated with this vendor. Length Restriction: QBO: 15 QBD: 1024

Vendor1099.description: The Vendor is an independent contractor, someone who is given a 1099-MISC form at the end of the year. The "1099 Vendor" is paid with regular checks, and taxes are not withhold on their behalf.

T4AEligible.description: Product: QBW Description: True if vendor is T4A eligible. Applicable for CA/UK versions of quickbooks.

T5018Eligible.description: Product: QBW Description: True if vendor is T5018 eligible. Applicable for CA/UK versions of quickbooks.

CurrencyRef.description: Reference to the currency all the business transactions created for or received from that vendor are created in.

TDSEnabled.description: Product: QBO Description: True, if TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) is enabled for this Vendor. If enabled, TDS metadata needs to be passsed in VendorEx field.

TDSEntityTypeId.description: Product: QBO Description: Entity Type of the Vendor.

TDSSectionTypeId.description: Product: QBO Description: Default TDS section type for the vendor to be used in transaction.

TDSOverrideThreshold.description: Product: QBO Description: True, if TDS threshold calculation should be overriden.

TaxReportingBasis.description: Product: QBO Description: The tax reporting basis for the supplier. The applicable values are those exposed through the TaxReportBasisTypeEnum. This is applicable only in FR.

APAccountRef.description: Product: QBO Description: The A/P account ID for the supplier. This is applicable only in FR where each supplier needs to have his own AP account.

VendorEx.description: Internal use only: extension place holder for Vendor.

GSTIN.description: GST Identification Number of the Vendor. Applicable for IN region only.

GSTRegistrationType.description: GST registration type of the Vendor. Applicable for IN region only.

IsSubContractor.description: Product: QBO only Description: True if the vendor is subcontractor

SubcontractorType.description: Specifies the Subcontractor type. Applicable only for UK region, values are defined in the SubcontractorTypeEnum.

CISRate.description: Specifies the CIS Rate. Applicable only for UK region, values are defined in the CISRateEnum.

HasTPAR.description: Product: QBO Only Description: True if the Vendor has TPAR. Applicable for AU region only.

VendorPaymentBankDetail.description: Product: QBO Only Description: Contains Bank Account details to enable Vendor Batch Payment. Applicable for AU region only.

Source.description: Product: QBO Description: Originating source of the Vendor. Valid values are defined in SourceTypeEnum

CostRate.description: Hourly cost rate of the Employee. QBO only. QBD Unsupporetd field.
